Hi Sofia — thanks for the note and for sending the draft. Quick answers up front:

- We can issue the final invoice in EUR if you prefer; we typically invoice in the currency of record but provide local-currency invoices for EU customers on request. If you want EUR, note that we lock conversion at the invoice generation date.
- We will include a discrete "Final true-up" line item showing the pro-rated credit and the net amount due.
- Payee/legal name for invoicing: Redwood Inference, Inc.
  VAT/TIN: US EIN 12-3456789 (for EU reverse-charge purposes we can populate the VAT field where applicable — let us know the billing/legal entity to list).
- Preferred reference on wires: please include the HubSpot deal id GFH-REN-2028-4578 as the reference so our payments team can auto-match.

Two options for completing payment:
1) SEPA / EUR wire — we attached SEPA instructions (redwood_sepa_instructions.csv). If you route through your bank, please include the reference above and send remittance to finance@redwood.com.
2) USD wire — follow the instructions in the attached PDF and we will handle any conversion.

Next steps for us: we will generate the finalized invoice PDF with the explicit true-up line and attach it to this thread once you confirm currency choice and billing remit name. If you can share the PO number and your remit contact (name + email + VAT/TIN if different from company records) we will push the invoice to "final" and mark the account for the expected payment date.

Can you confirm by EOD Friday (Mar 24) so we can lock the invoice? If timing slips, we will re-run FX pricing on the invoice date.

Regards,

Hi Sofia — copying Finance to provide the operational steps. Thanks for the clarity on timelines. A few practical items to ensure a clean collection: 

1) If you will pay via SEPA (EUR), we ask that you:
   - Send the PO with the exact legal/billing name as it should appear on the invoice.
   - Use reference GFH-REN-2028-4578 on the wire (this allows auto-apply).

2) Tax / withholding — because Redwood is a US entity, if Greenfield is requesting any withholding proof or requires a Local VAT invoice, please confirm. For EU entities under reverse-charge, we will populate VAT fields accordingly, but we will need your VAT number and the billing entity.

3) Vendor setup — attached is our standard vendor form. If your AP team requires additional bank confirmation or supplier profile fields, please return that completed document so our Treasury team can verify routing without hold.

4) If you prefer us to issue EUR-nominated invoice we will create it and lock FX on the invoice creation time. Alternatively, if you pay in USD into our USD account we will convert on receipt and record the net as cleared.

If you are able to confirm PO + remit details today, we will issue the final PDF invoice and a separate remittance email with bank copy for your treasury.
